page.overview:
Who is Officer 227?

Officer 227 is a Duelist Construct of Officer 227 from the Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V series in the Virtual Dueling System. He is also the opponent that the player faced in Stage 20-1 of the ARC-V Campaign mode in Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Generation. The player has to defeat him in a Duel in order to unlock the next stage and progress Campaign mode.

As a Duelist Construct, his appearance is based on Officer 227, and the outfit is what he normally wore while being a officer of the Sector Security in the Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V anime series. Sector Security is a law enforcement agency led by a Director who commands the officer to maintain the duty of law and order in New Domino City, and as such, 227 being a officer must uphold the rule to bring balance toward the people living in the city.

The name "Officer" refers to his occupation while his other name "227" refers to his code name in the Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V anime series. The number for his code name "227" could be a reference toward the 227 rules for fully ordained monks in Theravada Buddhism.

There are a total of six rewards that the player can earn and received after defeating the Duel Construct in a Duel. The first two rewards are cards that come from the Duel Construct's Deck and the third reward is a recipe for their Deck. Then the fourth, fifth and sixth rewards repeated the same process of the three earlier rewards, but in a harder difficulty with a different Deck. In addition, the sixth reward will allow the player to have the Duel Construct's avatar and the ability to Duel them anytime between the two difficulty.
